MAME 80186 CPU and standalone compatibility layer

Imported from https://github.com/daiverd/doubletalk-pc
Commit: b1a93202a9150d2f989deaadc64ded00bb6955aa
CPU files: doubletalk/mame/
Compatibility layer: doubletalk/shim/
Upstream CPU project: https://github.com/mamedev/mame

All imported files retain their BSD-3-Clause license and copyright headers.
The LICENSE file covers the standalone compatibility layer; CPU attribution
is retained in each CPU source file, including the EB fork's modifications.

Local changes:
- shim/emu.h: reserve seven address spaces rather than four and bounds-check
  optional-space queries. The CPU queries AS_STACK/AS_CODE/AS_EXTRA (4..6).

The Courier adapter uses the 16-bit i80186_cpu_device and routes all memory
and I/O accesses to Courier devices. It does not use the fork's incomplete
80C188EB peripheral model or the DoubleTalk board/firmware.
